intro.text: A Terris Steelrunner, the only one Wax's grandmother Vwafendal can name who might be involved in Winsting Innate's murder.
A Terris Steelrunner from the Village, whom Bleeder killed in order to steal her Feruchemy.

items.text: Idashwy grew up in the Village but often slipped out as a girl; Wax remembers her as shy, with golden hair. As an adult she moved to the Bournton District to keep the books for a jeweler. About a month before Lady ZoBell's party she began acting strangely, saying her dead brother's spirit visited her, and then vanished. Wax found her body in her kitchen and recognized a Hemalurgic spike wound from the book Ironeyes had sent him.
